notes: Masha_Body carries no morph targets; all face morphs live on Masha_Head (brows, lashes, teeth, tongue joined in). Masha_Eyes carries no morphs; it is skinned to the eye bones.

Rest pose has closed lips. Visemes are LIP-ONLY (no jaw): the jaw opens only through jawOpen (pre-scaled x0.6: 1.0 is the natural maximum, speech uses 0.15-0.6). See the 'lipsync' block and docs/MASHA_LIPSYNC.md for the rest-closure and seal rules.
Normalise the viseme blend (sum of viseme weights <= 1); jawOpen is driven separately.

lipsync.doc: docs/MASHA_LIPSYNC.md#morph-contract. Resolve morphs BY NAME (indices are listed for reference; 0-30 are unchanged from contract v1, the 16 lip-sync targets are appended).

morphs.name: mouthSmileLeft
morphs.doc: Smile corner. Relative.

morphs.name: mouthSmileRight
morphs.doc: Smile corner. Relative.

morphs.name: mouthFrownLeft
morphs.doc: Frown corner. Relative.

morphs.name: mouthFrownRight
morphs.doc: Frown corner. Relative.

morphs.name: jawOpen
morphs.doc: Jaw drop (chin, lower teeth, tongue, mouth floor). The ONLY jaw opening. x0.6 pre-scaled: 1.0 = natural maximum; speech 0.15-0.6.

morphs.name: mouthPucker
morphs.doc: Lips pushed forward, closed round (kiss). Absolute (restUndo 1).

morphs.name: mouthPress
morphs.doc: Lips pressed together (L+R). Relative.

morphs.name: mouthLeft
morphs.doc: Whole mouth to her left. Relative.

morphs.name: viseme_aa
morphs.doc: A (father, casa). Lips-only: slightly raised upper lip, lips parted by the jaw.

morphs.name: viseme_E
morphs.doc: E (bed, mesa). Lips spread, upper teeth shown.

morphs.name: viseme_I
morphs.doc: I (see, sí). Strong spread.

morphs.name: viseme_O
morphs.doc: O. Rounded + protruded (MPFB O + 0.3 funnel + 0.15 pucker).

morphs.name: viseme_U
morphs.doc: U / W glide. Tight round + protrusion (MPFB U + 0.6 pucker + 0.3 funnel).

morphs.name: viseme_PP
morphs.doc: P/B/M. Lips sealed and pressed, slightly rolled; sealed at any jaw with the seal rule.

morphs.name: viseme_FF
morphs.doc: F/V(en). Lower lip up and tucked under the upper incisors; upper incisors shown.

morphs.name: viseme_SS
morphs.doc: S/Z(seseo). Lips spread, teeth close (jaw <= 0.15).

morphs.name: viseme_DD
morphs.doc: T/D. Tongue tip raised to the alveolar ridge.

morphs.name: viseme_CH
morphs.doc: CH/SH/LL(y). Lips protruded and squared, teeth close.

morphs.name: viseme_kk
morphs.doc: K/G/J(x). Lips neutral-open, tongue back (not visible).

morphs.name: viseme_nn
morphs.doc: N/L/Ñ. Tongue tip at the alveolar ridge, lips relaxed.

morphs.name: viseme_RR
morphs.doc: R (MPFB/Meta RR: English r, mild lip rounding) + tongue tip up 0.7. For the Spanish tap/trill prefer viseme_nn/DD lips with a short RR accent.

morphs.name: viseme_TH
morphs.doc: Dental θ/ð (Spain z/c, English th). Tongue tip between the incisors: needs jawOpen >= 0.12 or the tip intersects the closed teeth.

morphs.name: mouthClose
morphs.doc: Lips sealed over an open jaw: mouthClose == jawOpen keeps the lips closed. Also the rest-closure correction channel.

morphs.name: mouthFunnel
morphs.doc: Lips funnel (open rounding). Relative modifier (anticipate O/U).

morphs.name: mouthRollLower
morphs.doc: Lower lip rolled in. Relative.

morphs.name: mouthRollUpper
morphs.doc: Upper lip rolled in. Relative.

morphs.name: mouthUpperUp
morphs.doc: Upper lip raised (L+R). Relative.

morphs.name: mouthLowerDown
morphs.doc: Lower lip lowered (L+R). Relative.

morphs.name: mouthShrugLower
morphs.doc: Lower lip pushed up/out. Relative.

morphs.name: mouthShrugUpper
morphs.doc: Upper lip pushed up/out. Relative.

morphs.name: mouthStretch
morphs.doc: Mouth corners stretched sideways/down (L+R). Relative.

morphs.name: mouthDimple
morphs.doc: Corners pulled back, dimples (L+R). Relative.

morphs.name: mouthRight
morphs.doc: Whole mouth to her right. Relative.

morphs.name: tongueOut
morphs.doc: Tongue out over the lower lip (tongue only). Use with jawOpen >= 0.3.

rest_closure_rule.doc: The basis has closed lips (C = 0.15 raw mouthClose, ~5 mm). Absolute shapes (restUndo > 0) each undo C once at weight 1. When their restUndo-weighted sum U exceeds 1 the lips would be opened (U-1) extra times; add mouthClose to put C back. Exact (linear).
rest_closure_rule.U: sum(restUndo_i * w_i)  (visemes 1, mouthPucker 1, jawOpen 0.6, all others 0)

seal_rule.doc: Lip-contact visemes are built sealed at jawOpen 0. If the jaw is open while they are active, add mouthClose so the lips stay in contact (mouthClose == jawOpen closes the lips over the jaw).

lipsync.order: final mouthClose = authored mouthClose + seal correction + rest-closure correction; clamp to [0, 1].
lipsync.reconstruction: viseme_X(1) + jawOpen(sourceJawOpen_X) + rest-closure correction == the original MPFB viseme (lips exact; chin/jaw-line skin within a few mm, teeth/tongue follow jawOpen).

eye_bones.rest: head at eyeball centre, bone points forward (-Y Blender / +Z glTF)
eye_bones.yaw: rotate about bone-local Z (positive = eye looks to character's left)
eye_bones.pitch: rotate about bone-local X (positive = eye looks up)

lid_follow.doc: upper lids follow vertical gaze via morphs (skinning lids to eye bones was rejected: it exposes the lid margin on look-up and drags inner-corner lashes on yaw)
lid_follow.look_down: eyeBlinkX += 0.45 * clamp(-pitch_deg / 20, 0, 1)   (added before the blink curve, final weight = max(blink, coupling + blink))

grapheme_to_viseme._doc: LEGACY (contract v1 letter-based lip-sync). Spanish/English letters -> viseme (weight). Digraphs first. Visemes are lip-only since v2: drive jawOpen separately. Consonants are short (40-70 ms) and blend 60% into the next vowel.
grapheme_to_viseme._note_es: Spanish 'v' is bilabial -> PP; English 'v' -> FF. 'c' before e/i and 'z' are /s/ (SS) or /θ/ (TH); 'c' before a/o/u, 'qu', 'k' -> kk.

blink.curve: close 70 ms (ease-in), hold 20-30 ms at 1.0, open 110-150 ms (ease-out); total ~210 ms
blink.extra: blink on large gaze shifts (>15 deg) and at the end of an utterance; while thinking lower rate (5-9 s); asymmetric offset L/R 0-15 ms

breathing.note: body clip or procedural on Spine1/2

gaze.follow_user: aim eye bones at the camera/user point; head (mixamorig:Head/Neck) takes 30-40% of large offsets with 250 ms lag, eyes take the rest immediately
gaze.vergence: both eyes aim at the same 3D point (user ~0.5-0.7 m) -> slight convergence

speaking.smoothing: critically damped, 25-30 1/s for mouth, 4 1/s for expressions

Masha_Eye.note: only the iris emits; keep eye emission <= 1 and exclude eyes from strong bloom (old avatar used emissive 6 on whole eyeballs -> glowing balls)

Masha_Teeth.note: re-graded CC0 texture: off-white enamel, muted dark-pink gums

Masha_MouthInterior.note: mouth cavity faces of the skin (flat colour, no texture); keep it non-emissive / dim in the hologram shader
